falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 2.5% above its prior 20-day closing high within 14 days, with that breakout day's volume above its 20-day average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed upside breakout would kill the mini_top_2019_jun analog and show HOLD was wrong; the tape resolved risk-on, not unknown/topping

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes more than 6% below its rolling 20-day high and VIX closes above 25 on the same day, within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A deep, volatility-confirmed break is not a June-2019-style mini top; HOLD and the 75% pattern match would be invalidated in favor of an active risk-off call

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints outside 40-70 (below 40 or above 70) and similarity to mini_top_2019_jun falls below 40%, both observed in the same 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The moderate-blowoff mini-top template that justifies UNKNOWN/HOLD no longer fits; the current verdict would be falsified by a regime the analog does not describe

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
